question: Article 43 ∶ The State shall endeavour to promote cottage industries on an individual or cooperative basis in rural are it is a Directive based on _____ Principles.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gandhian**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 43** of the Indian Constitution is based on **Gandhian principles**.
 
• This article directs the state to promote **cottage industries** on an individual or cooperative basis in rural areas.
 
• It aims to improve the economic conditions of rural areas by encouraging small-scale, traditional industries.
 
• The **promotion of cottage industries** aligns with Mahatma Gandhi's vision of a self-reliant rural economy.
 
• This directive principle is part of the broader goal to achieve social and economic democracy in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)** are guidelines for the framing of laws by the government, provided in** Part IV** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• They are not enforceable by any court, but they are considered fundamental in the governance of the country.
 
• The DPSPs aim to create social and economic conditions under which the citizens can lead a good life.
 
• They also aim to establish social and economic democracy through a welfare state.
 
• **Article 43** reflects the **Gandhian ideology** of promoting rural development and self-sufficiency.
 
• Other Gandhian principles in the DPSPs include the** promotion of village panchayats** (**Article 40**) and the prohibition of intoxicating drinks and drugs (Article 47).
